embeds.title: Day 7 shipped — Phase 1 done · Producer touchpoint #1 open
embeds.description: Tier 1 is fully playable end-to-end. Day 7 closes Phase 1 with on-screen feedback during the shift (live HUD), defensive store hygiene, and boundary-case test coverage. **65/65 tests pass.** STATUS.md is rewritten as the touchpoint brief — see below for the five concrete questions.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 65/65 tests · vite 13s · 531 KB gz

fields.name: Live Shift HUD (TopStrip)
fields.value: `ShiftHUD.tsx` shows shift id + tier · 5-block spawn meter (filled cyan as incidents arrive) · running ●N on-time count · draining time-left bar (emerald → amber → crimson) that flips to `ENDED` at completion. Hidden until a shift is loaded.

fields.name: Defensive loadShift
fields.value: Arming a new shift now resets `game_min` to 0 and unpauses, so a re-load can't accidentally start the player mid-clock. Covered by a smoke test through useFloor.

fields.name: +7 edge-case tests
fields.value: High-speed multi-spawn jump (game_min jumps from 0 to 10 in one frame → both due incidents fire) · exact-boundary spawn timing (≥, not strict >) · deadline-as-in-window boundary (resolved AT due_by → in_window) · cancelled outcome · on-scene-at-end → missed · 0.80 score → grade B · defensive loadShift smoke.

fields.name: STATUS.md (rewritten)
fields.value: Now reflects Day 0–7 actuals + per-day commits + a 6-row test inventory. Opens [touchpoint #1](https://github.com/kjhholt-alt/operator-sim/blob/master/STATUS.md) with the questions below.

fields.name: ❓ Touchpoint #1 — Does it feel like Operator Sim?
fields.value:
**1.** Pacing — does Tier 1 at 1× feel deliberate or boring? At 4× do you lose track?
**2.** Shift HUD — does the spawn meter + on-time counter + time bar give a useful read?
**3.** End-of-shift summary — is the S/A/B/C/D grade the right resolution, or do we need a debrief screen?
**4.** Discoverability — Ctrl+K reveals everything, but a new player wouldn't know that. Tutorial pop-up needed, or is the BottomTicker hint enough?
**5.** Should Tier 1 introduce all 5 incident types — or front-load with one type so the player learns the loop before variety lands?

fields.name: Phase 2 backlog (if green-lit)
fields.value: 2nd shift at Tier 2 (denser pacing) · multi-unit incidents (engine + ambulance for MVAs) · police agency (`patrol`, `k9`, agency-aware routing) · full QC bbox tile-and-merge · `save` / `replay` verbs.
